recognize_zh: 兩張背部皮膚臨床照片：左圖是全身散佈的紅紫色斑塊與丘疹，部分中央有出血結痂與潰瘍（進展期皮膚 T 細胞淋巴瘤）；右圖為全身皮膚電子治療（TSET）後色素沉著、多處潰瘍與大片黃綠色焦痂（eschar）。
features: Clinical photograph composite of the trunk (non-microscopic)
Left panel: innumerable erythematous-violaceous papules, plaques and nodules, many with hemorrhagic crusts and central ulceration
Left panel: coalescing plaques forming a larger ulcerated tumor-stage lesion
Right panel: diffuse post-radiation hyperpigmentation with residual scaly pink macules
Right panel: multiple punched-out ulcers and a large irregular eschar with yellow-green slough
describe_en: Paired clinical photographs of the trunk. Before treatment, there are widespread erythematous to violaceous papules, plaques and ulcerated nodules with hemorrhagic crusting, consistent with advanced cutaneous T-cell lymphoma. After total skin electron beam therapy, the plaques have flattened into hyperpigmented patches, but there are multiple ulcers and a large eschar with slough, consistent with radiation-related skin injury with possible superinfection. Histologic diagnosis cannot be assessed from clinical photographs.

ddx.dx: Primary cutaneous anaplastic large cell lymphoma / lymphomatoid papulosis
ddx.vs: LyP shows self-healing crops of papulonodules and C-ALCL solitary tumors, with CD30-positive large cells on biopsy.

ddx.dx: Primary cutaneous CD8+ aggressive epidermotropic cytotoxic T-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: This entity presents with rapidly ulcerating necrotic lesions and is separated by CD8+/cytotoxic phenotype on biopsy.
Infectious ulcers require culture and histology showing organisms rather than atypical lymphoid infiltrate.
